summary: Created Redux store with smsSlice containing messages array, loading, and error state. Defined MessageStatus enum and Message interface in sms.types.js. Implemented addMessage, updateMessageStatus, removeMessage, setLoading, and setError reducers. Added selector functions (selectAllMessages, selectMessageById, selectPendingMessages, selectMessagesByStatus). Wired up Redux Provider in main.jsx. All 8 tests pass and build succeeds.
